seo.heading: Complete, Free & Privacy-First PDF Toolkit
seo.p1: Pödüfü.online offers a full suite of cloud-free, lightning-fast PDF tools designed for professionals, students, and everyday users. Whether you need to merge business contracts, compress large lecture slides, or convert spreadsheets to PDF, our platform handles your tasks seamlessly without registration or annoying watermarks.
seo.p2: Privacy is at the core of Pödüfü. Your uploaded documents are processed within isolated temporary sandboxes and automatically purged right after download. We never store, inspect, or share your sensitive documents.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, completely free. There are no hidden subscription tiers, no page count restrictions, and no watermarks added to your converted documents.
faq.q2: Are my files and data safe?
faq.a2: Absolutely. All file transfers are encrypted with HTTPS/SSL. Files are held in temporary sandboxes solely for the duration of the conversion and are permanently purged immediately after.
faq.q3: Can I use Pödüfü on my smartphone or tablet?
faq.a3: Yes! Pödüfü is fully responsive and optimized for mobile browsers across iOS (iPhone, iPad) and Android devices.

legal.privacy_body:
Pödüfü.online values user privacy and document security above all else.


1. Document Security: All uploaded files (PDF, Word, Excel, images) are processed strictly to perform the requested conversion or editing task.


2. Zero Permanent Storage: Your documents are never permanently stored on our servers. Workspaces are automatically deleted immediately after completion (within a maximum of 1 hour).


3. No Third-Party Sharing: Your documents are never shared with third parties, advertisers, or AI training datasets.


4. GDPR & Privacy Compliance: Our service complies with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
